5362 jhāṭa m. 'forest, arbour' lex. 2. *jhāṭṭa-. 3. *jhāṇṭa-. 4. *jhiṭṭa-. [PMWS 63 ← Mu.: cf. *jhalla-]
    1. Pk. jhāḍa- n. 'bush, thicket' (cf. jāḍī- f. 'clump, mass of creepers'); S. jhāṛu m. 'tree' (cf. jhātari f. 'brushwood'); L. jhāṛ m. 'large tree'; P. jhāṛ m. 'thornbush'; WPah bhal. j̈hāṛ n. 'hillside covered with bushes and grass'; Ku. jhāṛ 'grass'; N. jhār 'small bush'; A. zār 'thicket, clump', zārni 'thick jungle'; B. jhāṛ 'tuft of grass, bush, thicket'; Or. jhāṛa 'bush, tree, forest', °ṛī 'thicket, low jungle'; Bi. jhār 'brushwood', °rā 'land covered with brushwood'; Bhoj. jhāṛ 'clump of trees'; H. jhāṛ, °ṛā m., °ṛī f. 'bush' (also chāṛ m., °ṛī f.); G. jhāṛ n. 'tree, plant'; M. j̈hāḍ n. 'bush, large or small tree'; Ko. jhāḍa n. 'bush'.
    2. Paš.lauṛ. ǰhāṭ, uzb. ǰōṭ 'mountain grass'; Or. jhāṭī 'brushwood', jhāṭuā 'broom'.
    3. K. zanḍ m. 'small shrub'; B. jhā̃ṭā 'broom'; Mth. jhā̃ṭi 'land producing brushwood'.
    4. S. jhiṭa f. 'small bush'.
